# OpenCodeReview

> OpenCodeReview is a self-hosted, source-available AI code reviewer for GitHub pull requests. It reviews every pull request with the Claude Code or Codex CLI, signed in with the Claude or ChatGPT account you already have, and posts the findings on the pull request. It is built for indie hackers and solo SaaS builders who have nobody else to review their code.

- Runs on your own machine or server with one Docker command: `git clone https://github.com/BridgLabs/opencodereview && cd opencodereview && docker compose up --build`, then open http://localhost:1421.
- Free for individuals and companies under 100 people and USD 1M in yearly revenue, including commercial use, under the PolyForm Small Business License 1.0.0. Larger companies need a commercial license from BRIDG LABS LTDA (contato@bridglabs.com).
- There is no OpenCodeReview account and no per-seat price. The only cost is the AI plan you already pay for.
- Your code stays on the machine that runs OpenCodeReview; reviews call your AI provider with your own sign-in.
- Supported plans: Claude Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise (Claude Code), ChatGPT plans that include Codex. Local models are not supported.
- Several accounts can be connected; when one hits its usage limit, the review continues on the next.
- Compared with hosted reviewers such as CodeRabbit or Greptile, which are billed per developer and run your code in their cloud, OpenCodeReview is self-hosted and uses the AI plan you already have.
